claims.sourceText: BDM International, Inc., Schedule 14D-9, filed 26 November 1997, CIK 0000870763, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/870763/0000950152-97-008353.txt
claims.text: TRW agreed to acquire BDM in November 1997: 'on November 20, 1997, BDM International, Inc. entered into a Merger Agreement with TRW Inc. and Systems Acquisition Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of TRW, pursuant to which that subsidiary has commenced a tender offer (the "Offer") to purchase all of the outstanding shares of BDM's common stock for a cash price of $29.50 per share.'

edges.label: TRW acquired BDM by cash tender offer, 1997
edges.note: BDM's own Schedule 14D-9 of 26 November 1997 recites the 20 November merger agreement with TRW Inc. and its subsidiary Systems Acquisition Inc. at $29.50 a share, and BDM filed a Form 15-12G on 29 December 1997.
